grammar.title: Fairly, quite with 相当
grammar.explanation: 相当 (xiāngdāng) means "fairly, quite, considerably" — a bit stronger and more formal than 很, describing a fairly high degree. It goes right before an adjective.

grammar.title: Not until... with 直到...才
grammar.pattern: 直到 + 时间/事件，(主语) + 才 + 结果
grammar.explanation: 直到 (zhídào) means "until, up to" — paired with 才 in the main clause, it says something didn't happen until a certain point. It stresses how long you had to wait for the result.

sentences.en: Please act according to the rules.

sentences.zh: 按照计划，我们明天出发。
sentences.en: According to the plan, we set off tomorrow.

sentences.zh: 他按照老师的方法学习。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ànzhào lǎoshī de fāngfǎ xuéxí.
sentences.en: He studies according to the teacher's method.

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎnrán, tā shuō de shì zhēn de.
sentences.en: Obviously, what he said is true.
